description: Dashboard measures again (every AIP provider call logs real tokens) plus the tool-result round-trip fix: conversation tool_call_id/tool_calls survive to the provider, so multi-step agent runs no longer die with HTTP 400 after the first tool.
features: Dashboard fixed: AIP calls now log measured tokens to usage_log.json (nothing ever called log_usage before, so all charts were zero).
Fixed tool-result round-trip: canonical messages keep tool_call_id and assistant tool_calls — follow-up calls no longer fail HTTP 400.
Loop provider errors now log the technical excerpt, not just the bare message.
Version synced to 0.13.0 in server APP_VERSION, pyproject.toml and updates.json.
